episodes.synopsis: Zenos, an unlicensed healer working in the shadows, works to fix what's ailing his patients.
episodes.title: An Equal Price

episodes.synopsis: Kicked out of his party for his unorthodox skills and humble origins, Zenos seeks a new way of life.
episodes.title: The Underground Healer in the Abandoned Part of Town

episodes.synopsis: An encounter with the chief of the orcs leads Zenos into a three-way standoff in the slums.
episodes.title: Turf War

episodes.synopsis: Zenos resolving the feud between the demihuman gangs attracts attention from an unwanted source.
episodes.title: A Righteous Hero

episodes.synopsis: Zenos' old party find themselves at an impasse, and wondering if they kicked out the reason for their success.
episodes.title: A Place to Belong

episodes.synopsis: A rampaging golem threatens the slums as Zenos is forced to organize a resistance.
episodes.title: The End of Adventure

episodes.synopsis: After having dealt with the the rampaging golem, Zenos and his friends visit a hot springs to recuperate.
episodes.title: Special Service

episodes.synopsis: Zenos attends class at the Royal Hospital's headquarters, under the assumed identity of "Zeno."
episodes.title: The Royal Hospital

episodes.synopsis: Zenos' gets an invite to the Goldran Laboratory, and a chance to track down Becker's missing student.
episodes.title: Faction Infiltration

episodes.synopsis: A request for Zenos to treat Lord Fennel's daughter ends up being complicated by her haughty attitude.
episodes.title: A Request from a Noble Lady

episodes.synopsis: Zenos is invited to a dinner party by Goldran, where he hopes to discover the truth.
episodes.title: Just a Normal Healer

episodes.synopsis: Zenos learns the truth behind Becker's investigation, and faces the question: are lives equal in value?
episodes.title: Choosing Who Lives
